subject.title: WORKING: All Microsoft Issues and PRs (refresh)

question: Should OpenClaw maintain a root-level Microsoft tracker generator that can update live PR bodies, rather than keeping this coordination work in GitHub queries, labels, or external maintainer tooling?
rationale: The patch adds a durable maintainer workflow and live GitHub mutation path; correctness fixes alone cannot determine whether that ownership and operational surface belong in the repository.

options.title: Decline repository ownership
options.body: Close or redirect the tracker workflow to external maintainer tooling and keep the repository free of generated issue inventories.

options.title: Sponsor a report-only tracker
options.body: Retain a narrowly scoped generator only after removing live PR-body mutation, adding deterministic verification, and assigning a code owner.

options.title: Sponsor controlled PR-body updates
options.body: Keep the update path only with explicit maintainer ownership, closing-syntax neutralization, reviewable dry-run output, and live-operation proof.

recommendation.title: Decline repository ownership
recommendation.body: Close or redirect the tracker workflow to external maintainer tooling and keep the repository free of generated issue inventories.

likelyOwner.reason: The available discussion signals point to this account for Microsoft-channel and repository-scope decisions, though the direct ownership trail is limited.
